label: 안채
note: NOT a single silhouette: three roofed masses at three depths (left wing / center hall set back in isometric perspective / right wing), each with its own ridgeRow/eaveRow/wallBaseRow/platformTopRow. Zone x-boundaries are placed in the transparent gaps between wings and hall (~5px gap on each side), so boundary placement is not precision-critical. Both wings also show a small outward wall bulge (y~515-548, likely a chimney) that finished_alpha captures automatically -- no separate window needed.

stages.label: 기단
stages.rationale: wing platform flattens at 611->612 (both wings); hall platform edge at 450->451.

stages.label: 골조
stages.rationale: solid wall/lattice-door texture hides the frame in all three zones (unlike daecheongmaru) -> single combined generated edit covering all three wall bands, clipped per zone. No roof yet in this stage.

stages.label: 지붕
stages.rationale: adds pure-crop roof bands (ridgeRow..eaveRow per zone) on top of s2's generated frame; same frame layer reused.
